jobs.title: Commercial Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Stäfa, Switzerland / Hybrid

At Sonova, we are committed to creating a world where everyone enjoys the delight of hearing. For our distributed wireless microphone (Roger) team, we are looking for a driven and analytical  Commercial Marketing Manager  to support impactful local execution and stakeholder alignment across markets.

Your responsibilities

• Contribute to business decisions across strategy, product development, pricing, marketing, and commercial execution

• Partner closely with local market teams, conducting regular reviews to understand needs, monitor performance, and derive actionable insights

• Support global and local teams in the rollout of product launches and marketing campaigns

• Monitor global business performance, analyzing sales, pricing, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

• Capture and share commercial best practices across markets to drive continuous improvement

• Lead and execute cross-functional business development projects, ensuring alignment and timely delivery

Your profile

• University degree, preferably in Business or Audiology

• 5–10 years of experience in a commercial, strategy, consulting, or similar role

• Solid understanding of commercial processes, ideally with exposure to sales or local marketing execution

• Proven ability to manage and influence multiple stakeholders across functions and markets, excellent communication and presentation skills

• Experience in project leadership and working in cross-functional, international environments

• Fluent English; additional languages are a plus

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset

What We Offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.
We offer a wide range of opportunities for both your professional and personal development.

• A dynamic, international environment with strong collaboration across teams

• Exposure to commercial strategy and execution in a global organization

• The chance to make a real impact on improving people’s quality of life #LI-NB1
